description: READ a setlist note (frontmatter `tracks`: an array of recipe ids or {title, recipe, preset, bpm, notes} objects, OR the newer `scenes`: an array of {id, cue, recipe, preset, steps, …} scene objects) and build each scene's recipe — CREATING the operators in TouchDesigner under parent_path — to pre-stage a show's visuals. Recipe ids resolve against both built-in and vault recipes; preset-only and cue-only scenes are skipped (recall them live via setlist_runner instead). Use dry_run:true to validate the note without touching TD. Returns the resolved note path and the lists of built vs skipped tracks. Requires a configured TDMCP_VAULT_PATH.

dry_run.description: Only resolve and report what would be built; do not touch TouchDesigner.

note.description: Setlist note: a vault-relative path, or a name resolved against the Setlists/ folder.

parent_path.description: COMP to build each track's recipe inside.

name: import_setlist
title: Import a setlist from the vault
